Separate privacy and publicity rights can apply to further use.

clips.scenario: A pedestrian follows a marked factory walkway. Another worker is partially visible by production machinery.
clips.changes: Lab filename only. Original mirror bytes retained.

clips.scenario: A loaded forklift crosses the production floor. Workers are visible near machinery. The source label describes load handling.
clips.changes: Lab filename only. Original mirror bytes retained.

verification: FFmpeg 7.1 decoded every frame and successfully encoded both clips using H.264 at 960×540 and 12 fps. Precise duration and average frame rate are from the pinned mirror metadata and agree with FFmpeg display precision.
coverage: The two camera views provide pedestrian and forklift activity for concurrent playback. Distances and forklift–pedestrian near misses are unverified.
